meta.title: Explicar conceptos complejos
meta.goal: Puedes adaptar una explicación a la audiencia mediante definiciones, analogías, ejemplos y comprobaciones de comprensión.

cards.title: Empieza por la decisión del oyente
cards.lede: Una explicación útil selecciona profundidad, vocabulario y ejemplos según lo que la persona necesita hacer.

rows.value: What does this person need to understand or decide?
What can I safely assume they already know?
What can I leave out without distorting the idea?
For this decision, the key point is that the model predicts patterns; it does not verify facts.

cards.title: Da primero un mapa y luego los detalles
cards.lede: Una frase de orientación reduce carga cognitiva y muestra cómo encajan las partes.

rows.value: There are three stages: collecting data, training the model, and evaluating its output.
Training means adjusting the model based on patterns in examples.
Evaluation is separate from training because it tests performance on unseen cases.
So the process moves from examples to pattern learning to an independent check.

cards.title: Define por categoría, rasgo y límite
cards.lede: Una buena definición dice qué es el concepto, qué lo distingue y qué no implica.

columns.label: Definición circular
examples: A scalable system is one that scales.

columns.label: Definición operativa
examples: A scalable system can handle growing demand without a comparable increase in cost or failure rate.

columns.label: Límite
examples: Scalable does not mean infinitely fast or free to operate.

cards.title: Usa una analogía y declara dónde termina
cards.lede: La analogía transfiere una estructura conocida; no demuestra que dos cosas sean idénticas.

rows.value: A cache stores frequently requested data for faster access.
Think of it like keeping everyday tools on your desk instead of retrieving them from storage.
The desk is the cache; storage is the slower original source.
Unlike a desk, a cache follows automatic rules and may contain copies that become outdated.

cards.title: Aclara sin infantilizar ni llenar de jerga
cards.lede: Sustituye densidad innecesaria por verbos concretos y conserva los matices esenciales.

lines.text: The system operationalizes asynchronous eventual consistency paradigms.
Updates may reach different servers at different times, but the servers are designed to agree eventually.
It's basically magic that makes everything sync.
A background process compares versions and resolves differences according to predefined rules.

cards.title: Comprueba comprensión con una tarea
cards.lede: “Do you understand?” suele producir un sí cortés; pide que la persona use o reformule la idea.

rows.value: How would you explain the trade-off in your own words?
Given this scenario, which option would you choose and why?
Which part is still unclear: how the data is collected or how the result is interpreted?
Let me try a different example and separate the two steps.

tip.label: Reto
tip.body: Explica el mismo concepto a un colega técnico y a un cliente. Conserva la verdad central, pero cambia detalle, jerga y ejemplo.

quiz.q: Which opening best orients a non-specialist?
options: Let me list every implementation detail first.
The process has three stages; I'll explain what each one contributes.
You probably know the underlying architecture.
quiz.explain: Un mapa inicial muestra estructura y reduce carga antes de añadir detalle.

options: It replaces the real explanation completely.
It maps relevant features and states where the comparison breaks down.
quiz.explain: Declarar correspondencias y límites evita inferencias falsas.

options: How would you apply this rule to the second case?
quiz.explain: Una tarea de aplicación revela si la persona puede usar la idea, no solo asentir.

options: Es magia y se arregla solo.
Un proceso compara versiones y resuelve diferencias con reglas definidas.
quiz.explain: Usa lenguaje concreto sin eliminar el mecanismo ni prometer resultados absolutos.
